comment: Blue is a very passionate professor who is knowledgable about the subject. He is also a great resource for students who are looking for jobs and internships at startups.

Blue is awesome, not a tough grader, super laid back. Great class and interesting topics, basically we looked at cool examples of innovation. Super encouraging , if you want to start your own business definitely take his class, actual material is valuable if you really read into it but Blue is really the biggest asset. Would take him 10/10 times.

Definitely take Blue Crump for any management class. I took him for managing innovation and enjoyed class a lot. He is willing to help outside of class for any projects you may be working on your own and is really invested in students. He's easy going and makes class enjoyable. Discussions and group projects were fun and interesting.
